Q-9911: What date is 199 days after 2024-08-30?

Calculation:
2024-08-30 + 199 days
- Aug 30 -> Sep 30: 31 days (Sep has 30 days, so Aug 30 + 31 = Sep 30)
- Sep 30 -> Oct 30: 30 days (total 61)
- Oct 30 -> Nov 30: 31 days (total 92)
- Nov 30 -> Dec 30: 30 days (total 122)
- Dec 30 -> Jan 29: 30 days (total 152) -- wait let me recount

Let me count carefully:
Aug 30 + 1 day = Aug 31
Aug has 31 days, so remaining in Aug: 1 day (Aug 31)
Sep: 30 days (total 31)
Oct: 31 days (total 62)
Nov: 30 days (total 92)
Dec: 31 days (total 123)
Jan: 31 days (total 154)
Feb: 28 days (total 182)
Mar: 31 days (total 213) -- too many, we need 199

So after 182 days we're at Feb 28, 2025.
199 - 182 = 17 more days into March.
March 17, 2025.

Answer: 2025-03-17
